## Change

What problem does this solve, and what happens differently?

## Validation

Which commands/comparisons actually ran? Include failures or checks not run.

For scientific changes: equations/assumptions, domain, independent reference and consumer error budget. For performance changes: matched numerical quality, wall time and memory.

## Limits

Any remaining qualification gaps, compatibility effects or follow-up work?

Keep local plans, bulk evidence, datasets and run stores out of the diff. AI-written contributions are welcome; the contributor remains responsible for the change.
